item.title: Blackout to blackout & pothole to pothole: cycling Cuba during U.S. fuel blockade
item.description: Former North Bay resident Larry Simpson cycles through the Cuban countryside seeing the impact of the U.S. blockade of fuel to the island.

item.title: Callander council tells staff to 'sharpen their pencils' and make cuts
item.description: Councillors balked at a proposed 6.15 per cent tax increase for 2026, and are on the hunt for ways to cut costs to bring it down.

item.title: Nipissing Lakers women's hockey team face Ontario Tech Friday morning in playoff qualifier
item.description: The Nipissing Lakers women's hockey team face their biggest game of the season Friday morning at 9 a.m. and have to play in West Ferris Arena when they meet the Ontario Tech Ridgebacks in a play-in game.

item.title: North Bay police officers took fewer sick days in 2025
item.description: Officers took less than four sick days on average last year, down from 4.5 the year before. Chief credits new wellness program.

item.title: North Bay Battalion hang on for wild win in Peterborough to gain on Petes
item.description: With their fourth win in a row North Bay's 63 points this season is one more than all of last year and the Troops still have 13 games left.
